data.text: I’m in, provided Jack joins and Luke keeps his catch at zero: I’ll catch 15 tons this month and donate the full $15,000 directly to the clinic. My family made its living on this lake; looking after the village means protecting both its people and its fish. I also commit to 6 tons next month, then 10 tons each month once the lake is back at 100, with everyone keeping those limits. Jack, will you join us so we can cover the clinic’s bill without taking any extra fish?
